title: Studio uploader approval manifest (v1)
description: One reviewer-approved manifest per video. Privacy is not a field: every upload is Private, never scheduled, never notifies subscribers. The authoritative validator is studio_uploader/manifest.py, which also enforces YouTube limits (title <= 100 chars, description <= 5000 bytes, tags <= 500 chars including quotes and separators, no '<' or '>').

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact approved file

channel_id.description: Must equal the pinned channel ID

source_filename.description: Name of the file in the staging folder at approval time

madeForKids.description: Audience. Explicit; there is no default

rights_note.description: How rights were cleared, by the reviewer

containsSyntheticMedia.description: Declared when altered or synthetic content is present. Never defaulted
